pool.text: Bolshoye Krivoshchyokovo village on the Ob River was founded
The Russian town originated at the future site of a bridge
The bridge was completed and made the settlement a transport hub
The first bank opened in the growing settlement
Novonikolayevsk was granted town status with full self-government rights
Novonikolayevsk instituted compulsory primary education in Russia
The city received its present name of Novosibirsk
Novosibirsk Academic Youth Theatre Globe was established
Novosibirsk State Academic Drama Theatre Red Torch was founded
Tram rails were laid down and population reached 287,000
Novosibirsk State Philharmonic Society was founded
Novosibirsk Opera and Ballet Theatre was established
Small Novosibirsk Planetarium was established
The trolleybus system was launched in the city
The population of Novosibirsk officially reached one million
The old Novosibirsk Bus Station on Krasny Avenue was opened
The modern building of the Novosibirsk Circus was built
The building of the river passenger terminal on the Ob opened
Novosibirsk was in the center of a solar eclipse path
Anatoly Lokot held the mayor position from this year
